scope: Actual four-mode command/policy functions and synthetic native API lifecycle, limits, save-state, cancellation and FIFO fixtures; no Android/WASM/network gameplay execution.
checks: towers: finite manufacturing preserves batch/FIFO validation and starts only explicitly requested units
towers: repeat schedules one native continuation after each completion without an unbounded waiting queue
towers: power/constructor/capacity waits and native rejection do not bypass ordinary engine authority
towers: repeat OFF retains the current unit and explicit FIFO but removes automatic unstarted continuations
towers: live repeat toggles require an actual matching plan; idle toggles cannot create a unit
towers: one STOP atomically cancels native current, clears all waiting/repeat and leaves other factories unchanged
towers: STOP failures preserve queue/policy and cannot acknowledge a false native cancellation
towers: repeat identity survives script save/load but clears on new level, destruction, ownership or player change
towers: duplicate command nonces never restart manufacture or repeat a completed STOP
towers: ownership, factory compatibility, invalid repeat values and 64-job cap stay enforced
